response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js skills, some cloud experience (AWS CDK, Kubernetes), and recent, directly relevant work on MCP code generators and agentic-workflow infrastructure at re:cinq. However, his AI-specific experience spans roughly one year, far short of the 8+ years of AI-driven solution development required, and the resume shows no evidence of vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM evaluation pipelines, or ML data pipelines. Customer-facing technical discovery leadership is also not demonstrated, making him a stretch for a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI role despite solid engineering fundamentals.
strengths: Hands-on experience building MCP servers/code generators and agentic-workflow tooling — a rare, directly relevant skill
15+ years of production software engineering across web, backend, and high-throughput distributed systems
Strong engineering-excellence culture: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Only ~1 year of GenAI/AI-agent work versus the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions
No demonstrated experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM evaluation, or ML data pipelines
Limited evidence of customer-facing technical discovery or forward-deployed/consulting-style delivery

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG/vector DB and evaluation-pipeline expertise
